This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This humanoid sentient species was distinguished by their [[Color|orange]] to gray gradient skin, as well as their [[Mouth|beaked mouths]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Unidentified-Beaked-Species-Body.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A member of this species on Coruscant]]
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="MandoDate">{{MandoDate|19}}</ref> a member of this species could be found on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] around the time [[Penn Pershing]] embarked on his [[mission to retrieve the mobile lab station]].<ref name="The Mandalorian">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 19: The Convert}}</ref> Less than a year later,<ref name="SkeletonCrewDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> another member of this species could be found enjoying themselves in the company of fellow [[Unidentified beaked head-tail species|alien]] at the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the planet [[Lanupa]] shortly before [[Jod Na Nawood]] and company arrived in search of [[Tak Rennod]]'s secret lair.<ref name="Skeleton Crew">{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}}</ref> Much later, in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TLJDate">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> a third member of this species was seen gambling at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack]] in [[Canto Bight]] on [[Cantonica]] when the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] arrived searching for the [[Master Codebreaker]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:King-19.jpg|thumb|right|200px|King 19 by Jake Lunt Davies]]
The species made their debut in the [[2017]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi]]'', directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> This species was designed by concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]], and concept art for it was titled King 19.<ref name="TLJ Art Book">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref> According to the Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], as of [[April 1]], [[2025]], this species still did not have a name within the official [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref>
